claims.reason: The duplication is real and the proposed refactor is sound. `forward_on_two_radius` (ForwardBound lines 14–38) and `exterior_displacement_le_radius` (target lines 14–36) do the same work. Both call `forward_kernel_remainder` and `capacity_le_radius_sq`. Both prove ‖capacity/z‖ = capacity/‖z‖ with the same `norm_div`, `norm_real`, `abs_of_pos P.capacity_pos` rewrite. Both apply `norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub` through capacity/z. Both bound 10·cap·R/‖z‖² + cap/‖z‖ by 3R using cap ≤ R². The ForwardBound version fixes ‖z‖ = 2R and uses `field_simp`/`ring`. The target version proves it for all ‖z‖ ≥ 2R, so it gives ‖P.forward z − z‖ ≤ 3R for ‖z‖ = 2R directly. This is a genuine error-estimate argument and not a short calculation. The general lemma needs only `forward_kernel_remainder`, `capacity_le_radius_sq`, `capacity_pos` and the same hypotheses as `forward_on_two_radius`. `forward_on_two_radius` already uses all three and `hz.ge`, so moving the lemma above it adds no import and no cycle. The target file imports SlitUniformForwardBound, so `inverse_uniform_bound` still sees the lemma. The rewritten `forward_on_two_radius` is: `have hd := P.exterior_displacement_le_radius hi h0 hH hR hp hzH hz.ge; have hsum := norm_le_norm_sub_add (P.forward z) z; rw [hz] at hsum; linarith`. This works because hd gives ‖forward z − z‖ ≤ 3R and hsum gives ‖forward z‖ ≤ ‖forward z − z‖ + 2R. Caveat: this is the same lemma moved upstream and not a new shared lemma. The benefit is one proof of the estimate instead of two near-duplicates.
claims.shared_lemma: lemma SimpleSlitChart.exterior_displacement_le_radius {p : C(unitInterval,ℂ)} (P : SimpleSlitChart p) (hi : Injective p) (h0 : p 0=0) (hH : ∀ t : unitInterval, t≠0 → p t∈upperHalfPlane) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0<R) (hp : ∀ t : unitInterval, ‖p t‖<R) {z : ℂ} (hzH : z∈upperHalfPlane) (hz : 2*R≤‖z‖) : ‖P.forward z-z‖≤3*R  -- proof unchanged; sketch: kernel remainder ≤ 10·cap·R/‖z‖², cap ≤ R², triangle inequality through cap/z, each term ≤ 5R/2 and R/2.
